content:
Hi all, very glad to be here. I'm a PhD candidate in Politics at Princeton and have been working on some political-economy related formalization in my free time.

As part of that work I've had to prove some things that might be useful upstream--I've submitted a PR (#36825) for Iic variants of some FTC-2 results in MeasureTheory/Integral/IntegralEqImproper. This was just mechanical work translating what's already in there, but hopefully more interesting things will come of this project. Thanks!
